consolidation_changes.note: Accepted hashes identify the original selected sources. Consolidated hashes include notice/link updates, formatting and the explicit review fixes below.

analyzer_rename.reason: The rule preserves early expression errors across arithmetic, casts, NULL branches and subqueries, not only Decimal NULL propagation.

workspace.members: Eight retained Sail crates now share the independent DAR Spark SQL workspace and its dependency overrides; vendor/sail/Cargo.toml settings moved to the root crate manifest.
workspace.test_profile: Development opt-level=1 retains the repository dependency profile when the vendored crates become testable workspace members. Debug assertions and overflow checks remain enabled.

review_fixes.change: Reject volatile functions during local planning-time evaluation even when column inputs are available.
Remove unselectable false precision-policy branches and the unused Array import; all existing call sites retain their selected policy.
Remove obsolete CAST-whitespace TODO contradicted by the accepted strict and legacy string casts.
Refresh outer-reference metadata after child expression simplification, preserving debug invariants and rejection of unsafe correlated scalar grouping.

consolidation_changes.diagnostic_wording: Replace extraction-probe wording in retained unsupported-operation errors with read-only-query or operation-specific errors; no new operations are admitted.
consolidation_changes.formatting: Apply the repository Rust formatter to consolidated Rust source.
consolidation_changes.registry_equivalents: Use the pinned registry packages for datafusion-expr-common and arrow-select: every Rust source and Cargo.toml was byte-identical to the accepted copies, so no local fork is needed.
